I wanted a drum machine I could open in a tab and start playing straight away - no install, no account, no sample library to download first. So I built BAP Studio. It is 16 velocity-sensitive pads across four banks, a 16-step sequencer with per-step velocity and swing, four patterns that chain into a song, and a sampler that takes any audio file or mic recording, finds the transients and lays the chops across the pads. Every sound is synthesised in the browser, so there is nothing to install and nothing to wait for. You can export a WAV, a MIDI file, or a link that rebuilds your beat exactly as you left it. Quickest way in: press Space to start the loop, then hit Z, C and A. Most people have something going in about a minute. Would love to hear what you make with it.

## A full drum machine that runs in a browser tab

BAP Studio is an online drum machine and beat maker built around the workflow of a classic 16-pad sampler. Every sound is synthesised in the browser, so there is nothing to install and nothing to wait for. Hit Z X C V, A S D F, Q W E R and 1 2 3 4 to play the pads, press Space to start the loop, and Enter to record.

### Finger drumming

Sixteen velocity-sensitive pads across four banks - 64 sounds in total. Hit a pad lower for a softer note, or plug in a MIDI pad controller and play with real velocity. Note repeat rolls a held pad on the grid for hi-hat rolls and trap hats.

### Step sequencer [...] The Jungle Break: Syncopated Snares at 172172 BPM
 Boom Bap at 90 BPM: the dusty backbeat90 BPM
 Dilla-style drunk swing87 BPM
 Four on the Floor124 BPM

## Frequently asked

### Is it really free?

Yes. There is no signup, no trial and no download. Everything runs locally in your browser.

### Can I use my own samples?

Yes - drop any audio file onto the sampler, or record through your microphone. BAP chops it automatically and you can drag individual slices onto pads.

### Does it work with a MIDI controller? [...] ### SHAPE

The PAD panel edits the last pad you hit: tune, volume, pan, attack/decay, filter, reverb & delay sends, gate mode, reverse, choke groups. FIT repitches a pad the last few cents so its sample lasts whole beats at the current tempo - so a second loop sits on the grid alongside the one you LOOPed the tempo to. The FILE menu (top right) keeps projects with SAVE and LOAD, exports WAV and MIDI, bounces the loop onto a pad with RSMP, and SHARE copies a link that rebuilds the beat. PREFS picks the face the sixteen pad names are engraved in. Everything autosaves.

# Make beats with an MPC-style drum machine in your browser

Play 16 drum pads with your keyboard, program patterns in the step sequencer, add swing and export your beat. Free, with no download and no signup.

Describe the bug

When you open link in the Android app with the "Open links with in-app browser" setting turned on, the browser will not remain open when the app is in the background.

To Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Turn on "Open links with in-app browser"
2. Open a link in the app
3. With the in-app browser open, switch to another open app (or return to the home screen)
4. Reopen the Bluesky app to observe the browser has closed

Expected behavior

The browser is still open when the app is reopened.
